# `synth/` fixtures

WAVs rendered from known MIDI by `scripts/make_fixtures.py`, so the ground truth is
the MIDI the audio was rendered from rather than a human annotation. This is the
backbone of every accuracy gate (ARCHITECTURE.md Appendix 5.6).

Generated by Phase 1, consumed from Phase 3 onward. The `.wav` files are not
committed; the source MIDI and the render recipe are.
